主要内容: On August 29, 2014, Core Laboratories N.V. entered into a Sixth Amended and Restated Credit Agreement with various financial institutions, with Bank of America, N.A. serving as administrative agent, swingline lender, and letter of credit issuing bank. The Amended Credit Agreement increases the aggregate borrowing commitment from $300 million to $350 million, with an option to raise it to $400 million if conditions are met. It extends the revolving credit facility maturity to August 29, 2019, and reduces loan pricing and commitment fees on unused portions. The description is not complete and is referenced to Exhibit 10.1 of the Form 8-K filing.
